name: AR_REMITTANCE_ADVICES_ALL
description: This table stores the receipt header information from remittance advices.

columns.name: REMITTANCE_ADVICE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the remittance advice.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of the payment.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the payment.

columns.name: CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the customer account that sent the payment.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the remittance advice. Valid values are derived from the AR_REMIT_ADVICE_STATUS lookup (New, IN_PROCESS, ERROR)

columns.name: CHECK_NUMBER
columns.description: Check number of the payment.

columns.name: RECEIPT_DATE
columns.description: Date of the receipt.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: User-entered comment about the remittance.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Currency conversion rates available on a given date.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate used to convert the foreign currency receipt amount to the ledger currency.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_DATE
columns.description: Date the foreign currency receipt amount was converted to the ledger currency.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the customer bank account

columns.name: PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Concurrent program who column - program id of the program that last updated this row (Foreign key to FND_CONCURRENT_PROGRAM.CONCURRENT_PROGRAM_ID).

columns.name: PROGRAM_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Concurrent program who column - date when a program last updated this row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the business purpose of the customer billing location associated with the receipt.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: REMIT_BANK_ACCT_USE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the remittance bank account assigned to the receipt.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Document IO file identifier. Foreign key to DocIO file record.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_REASON
columns.description: Customer reason codes associated with the remittance.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_REFERENCE
columns.description: Customer reference associated with the remittance.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: DEPOSIT_DATE
columns.description: Deposit date of the remittance.

columns.name: POSTMARK_DATE
columns.description: Postmark date of the receipt. Used for discount calculation.

columns.name: STRUCTURED_PAYMENT_REFERENCE
columns.description: Industry standard reference on Receivables transactions composed of letters, check digits, and transaction information, used to identify the transaction, transaction lines, and its payments to the customer and bank.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_DETAILS
columns.description: Paying customer details in the remittance advice.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the customer from Customer Details.

columns.name: BANK_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the bank transaction.

columns.name: ADVICE_OBJECT_REFERENCE
columns.description: Oracle internal only

columns.name: CREATED_FROM
columns.description: Source of the remittance advice.

columns.name: ASSOCIATED_CASH_RECEIPT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the receipt associated with the remittance advice.
